reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fix `knownhosts key mismatch` regression bug by @matheuscscp in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5404", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Environments that hit the `knownhosts key mismatch` regression stop encountering it after upgrading to 2.7.0; no operator action is mentioned in the evidence.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade to Flux 2.7.0; the evidence mentions no configuration change.

proposed.statement: Flux 2.7.0 fixes the `knownhosts key mismatch` regression bug (fluxcd/flux2 PR #5404), so the error no longer occurs after upgrading.
